title: Yeh Daard Sakina Ko Tah Hashar Rulaye Gah
body:
Asghar Ka Paani Peena, Baba Ka Zakhmi Seena, Issay Bhool Na Paaye Gah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindan Ki Tanhayi Din Raat Rulati Hai
Ab Tak Bhi Khayalon Main Asghar Ko Bulati Hai
Yeh Ghum Nahin Bhula Bhayi Ka Khali Jhoola
Ab Kon Jhulaye Gah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir Kay Haathon Peh Islam Ka Baani Hai
Sharminda Sakina Say Dariyaon Ka Paani Hai
Hurmal Ka Teer Dekho Asghar Ki Kis Tarah Say
Ub Pyaas Bhujaye Gah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadaat Peh Karbal Main Shaam-e-Ghareeban Aayi
Maqtal Main Sakina Yeh Daiti Rayhi Dhuayi
Ujray Howay Is Ran Main Baba Teray Lashay Ko
Ab Kaun Uthaye Gah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazaar Main Rooti Ti Darbaar Main Rooti Ti
Ab Khakh Hi Bistar Hai Jo Seenay Peh Sooti Ti
Teray Baad Meray Mola Ab Kaun Sakina Ko
Seenay Peh Sulaye Gah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Masooma Ka Ghum Likhna Shahid Ki Ibaadat Hai
Hum Kartay Hain Saab Mataam Bibi Ki Inayaat Hai
Zahra Ka Yeh Wada Hai Woh Jayega Jaanat Main
Jo Ashk Bahay Ga.
